text:
Priya (VP Product): @here Quick all-hands reminder — Thursday 10:00am PT in the main room. Agenda below, plus a small pre-flight ask. Please read and drop questions (or 'demo' requests) in-thread. :calendar:

Priya (VP Product): Agenda (40 min total): 1) Quick product & GTM wins (Nora) 2) Launch callouts + runbook highlights (Marco) 3) Short security & policy update (Elena) 4) Incident summary & learnings (SRE team) 5) Open Q&A and 2x lightning demos.

Priya (VP Product): Pre-flight asks: - Add one question you want asked by EOD Wed (thread below). - If you want a 3-minute demo, reply with "demo" + a 1-sentence blurb. - Review the draft slides here: https://redwood.internal/allhands/2026-03-draft (comments open).

Marco (Eng Manager): For the launch callouts I'll highlight API behavior changes and canary checklist. If your team has a special config to call out (eg. private deployment routing), DM me the exact text by Wednesday.

Nora (CTO): I'll open with a 90s product snapshot and call out two engineering themes: predictability and cost controls. Also will summarize a small policy tweak we agreed with Legal.

Elena (SRE): Security/policy teaser: starting Apr 1 we are enabling automated prompt redaction for dev logs (config flag: `redwood.log.pii_redact=true`) to reduce sensitive token exposure. Implementation details + rollout plan will be on slide 6. Please surface any blockers before the meeting.

Jamie (Sales): Can we include a 30s note about partner onboarding windows? Customers in EU will get a scheduled maintenance window for the Dedicated onboarding next month — need the exact phrasing.

Priya (VP Product): Good call, Jamie — Marco will add a short script for CS to copy into partner emails.

Elena (SRE): Incident note (short): Yesterday 03:15–03:45 UTC we saw a cache mismatch cascade causing 5XX on /v1/generate for ~12% of requests in one AZ; failover and circuit-breakers limited impact. Postmortem draft is in #postmortems; TL;DR will be in the all-hands (root cause: stale slot mapping between runtime and router; fix: immediate sync + improved detection).

sre-bot: Recording will be attached after the meeting.

Marco (Eng Manager): Runbook highlight we'll show: how to promote a model variant between regions, and the automatic fallback policy when Dedicated capacity is constrained. Asking infra folks to test this in staging by Thurs morning.

Priya (VP Product): Logistics: 10:00am PT sharp, please join 5 min early if you're presenting. We'll keep Q&A to chat first then call picks 6 live questions. Recording + slides will be posted immediately after.

Elena (SRE): Small follow-up on the policy: retention for developer debug logs will be shortened to 90 days for hosted accounts by default; Dedicated customers can opt for custom retention via contract. We'll post the policy RFC after the all-hands.

Jamie (Sales): Can someone confirm if this impacts our demo environments? I can coordinate if we need exceptions for enterprise demos.

Marco (Eng Manager): Jamie — demo envs are exempted until we flip the flag in prod; we can add a 30-day buffer for sales/demo accounts.

Priya (VP Product): Thanks team. If you can't make it but have questions for the execs, drop them below and Nora or I will read them live. See you Thu. :megaphone:

devex-bot: Reminder: if you requested a demo slot, upload a 2-slide deck to the all-hands folder by EOD Wed.

(Thursday meeting — post meeting)

sre-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2423456789-2026-03-26.mp4

Priya (VP Product): Thanks everyone who presented and joined. Quick takeaways: - Roadmap focus: predictable latency and cost-per-token improvements. - Launches: new canary for region-based fallback begins next week. - Policy: prompt redaction + 90-day dev log retention. - Incident: root cause identified; new detection alert in place. Slides + recording above.

Nora (CTO): Appreciate the crisp runbook demos — they made the rollout callouts much easier for Product and Ops. Action: Eng leads, follow up with rollout schedules in #eng-releases by EOD Fri.

Elena (SRE): Postmortem note: full postmortem link is in #postmortems. Short action items: 1) add sync healthchecks to router (done), 2) increase canary coverage to 2 AZs (in progress), 3) add alert for mapping divergence (done).

Marco (Eng Manager): Thanks for the great questions in Q&A — flagged two follow-ups for infra and devex.

Jamie (Sales): Quick customer-facing blurb for CS: "No customer data was exposed; the incident affected request availability briefly in one AZ. Our systems already had fallbacks; we've improved detection and resiliency." Please confirm if that wording is OK to use.

Elena (SRE): That wording is good. Add: "We rolled back the stale mapping within 30 minutes and mitigation is in place."

Priya (VP Product): Closing note: if you asked a question and didn't hear it live, DM me — we'll make sure execs answer. Thanks all. :tada:
